method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied (the worker), with a second seat layer for the person conducting the business or undertaking, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (work under a State or Territory WHS law answers `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Work Health and Safety Act 2011, Compilation No. 16, compilation date 1 July 2024 (register id C2024C00243, retrieved 2026-10-13), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2011A00137.txt. No instrument brought in: the Work Health and Safety Regulations 2011 are not deposited; Schedule 4 penalties are the printed figures before indexation (the cl 4 formula was lost in conversion). Added 2026-10-23: the Work Health and Safety Regulations 2011, Compilation No. 28 (F2025C00381), deposited at subjects/au/work-health-and-safety-regulations-2011, read by whs-regulations.l4 (regs 12A, 22, 23, 24, 699). Added 2026-10-24: Schedule 4 cl 4(2)'s formula, A x (B / C), from the formulas sidecar ../../registers/source-bundle/C2011A00137.formulas.md (restored from the authorised rendering of C2024C00243), read by whs-penalty-indexation.l4 with cls 4, 5 and 7; the CPI numbers are inputs (none deposited).

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run whs-worker.l4 ; l4 run whs-seat-pcbu.l4 ; l4 run whs-cases-worker.l4 ; l4 run whs-cases-pcbu.l4 ; l4 run whs-regulations.l4 ; l4 run whs-cases-regulations.l4 ; l4 run whs-penalty-indexation.l4 ; l4 run whs-cases-penalty-indexation.l4
checks.result: 172 assertions satisfied (44 + 24 + 20 + 84), 2 #TRACE runs FULFILLED, 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: Worker seat: ss 5(7)-(8), 7(1), (2A) (worker), 12(1)-(2), (4), (6), 12A (application), 17, 19 (duties owed), 47-49 (consultation), 50 (HSR election), 80(1), 81(2), 82 (unresolved issues), 84-86, 88 (ceasing unsafe work; s 85 direction as an input), 28 (worker duties), 30A-34 and Schedule 4 cl 1 (penalties before indexation), 35-37 (notifiable incidents), 105, 106, 112, 113, 115(a) (discrimination for raising safety). PCBU seat: ss 38(1)-(4), (7), 39, 47-49, 87, 30A-33 with Schedule 4. Out: ss 20-27, 29, 46, Part 4, Part 5 Div 3 beyond s 50, Divs 4 and 7, Part 6 Div 2, Part 7, Parts 8-14, Schedule 4 cls 3-5, Schedules 1-3; State and Territory WHS laws (not covered). Added 2026-10-23 (whs-regulations.l4, worker seat): regs 12A, 22, 23 (default procedure and written agreement as regulative rules), 24, 699. Added 2026-10-24 (whs-penalty-indexation.l4, worker and PCBU seats): Schedule 4 cls 1-5 and 7 -- the cl 1 categories, cl 2 tiers A to I and cl 3 civil penalty tiers 1 to 4, indexed under cl 4 and rounded under cl 5 for the year (from 1 July, cl 7) that includes a day; s 30A penalties are not indexed; cl 6 (the regulator's notice) out.
seat: the worker carrying out work for a business or undertaking the Commonwealth Act covers; and, in whs-seat-pcbu.l4, the person conducting the business or undertaking
seats: person conducting a business or undertaking
